events.title: v0.1.1 - demo Update is out now!
events.summary: Hey there ladies and gentlemen! The Bloody Duke demo has received its first update since its release. There will be more patches and updates to come!Changes for v0.1.1 - demo:Slightly increased invincibility frames for dodgingTweaked and fixed the charge-up for Erinyes' FuryFixed a bug where players could save at Erinyes' Echoes while having a menu openedImproved enemy trackingFixed an issue where player settings would reset after beating a boss or when achieving the Second Retreat endingSlightl

events.title: Demo Trailer + Steam Page are now Live!
events.summary: Hey there everybody! As you well know the demo trailer and the steam page for Bloody Duke went live just yesterday! Just for context, this is my first time ever releasing a project as big as this to the public, so it will take a while until I get my bearings. The demo is in its polishing stage at the moment being tested and tweaked - all is going well so far! It will keep its October 16th 2026 release date. Soon enough it will have its own page, separate from the main page, so players can leave
